correctness.rationale: For exactly the 35 triples of [7], adjacency in the Kneser disjointness graph means disjointness, so independent faces are pairwise-intersecting families. Published rational homology concentration in degrees 6 and 9 and ranks (29,7) is an explicit external premise. Each six-ground-set cross-polytope is the join of ten S^0 factors; seven top classes form a basis by the cited independent-sphere theorem. A six-point transposition has orientation -1, so the degree-9 module is sgn_7 tensor the seven-point permutation module, with character sgn(g)*number of fixed ground points. For each of 15 conjugacy classes, partition the 35 triples into g-orbits, retain internally intersecting orbits, make quotient disjointness graph Q_g; g-invariant simplices biject to its independent sets. The orientation and Euler signs combine to the exact reduced Lefschetz number -I(Q_g;-1), yielding chi_6=-I(Q_g;-1)+chi_9. Independent reconstruction matched all 15 class values (identity chi6=29, chi9=7; transposition chi6=1, chi9=-5), transposition orientation, and the finite signed-Lefschetz recurrence. Orthogonal rational S7 irreducible characters then produce degree-6 Specht (7)+(4,3)+(2,2,2,1), dimensions 1+14+14; degree-9 (1^7)+(2,1^5), dimensions 1+6. No integral or larger-ground-set claim is made.

originality.rationale: The new invariant is the complete graded *equivariant* Q[S7]-module, not the previously proved Betti numbers. The closely matching 20-page Feng 2026 primary paper was read through its main Theorem 18, induction, Section 7 and appendix; it gives dimensions only, not the 15 character values or Specht decomposition. Feng–Wang 2024 supplies seven embedded degree-nine spherical classes and Fano-based degree-six classes, not their full S7 action. Published records about stable Kneser and Kneser neighborhood complexes concern different ground sets or simplicial complexes. No equivalent S7 character was located in searches; this is best-of-knowledge, not a proof of historical absence.
